content.short: Paideia is a DAO management software suite, designed to make it easy for anyone to create, manage and be involved.
content.description: Paideia is an organization built on both Ergo and Cardano blockchains whose purpose is to create a functional, secure, and well-documented DAO software suite that supports DAOs as they form and develop. It will make it easy for anyone to initiate a DAO, distribute tokens using various methods, create proposals and collect votes. It will help various organizations share funds in a secure and fair way. Anyone who needs to manage a treasury as a group will benefit from these tools.
content.meta: Find out about Paideia (PAI) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
